out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED PORK ROLLS ON COUNTER USING TPHC WITHOUT BEING LABELED WITH END TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: PORK ROLLS LABELED WITH START AND END TIME.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Curing Food
violations.observation: The person in charge described a specialized processing method of food preservation (FERMENTATION/ACIDIFICATION) requiring a variance from the Health Department is used for the following meat, fish, poultry, game animal, or ratite product: OBSERVED FERMENTED PORK AT FACILITY. PIC STATED PORK IS FERMENTED AT ROOM TEMPERATURE FOR AROUND A DAY AND THEN MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1) smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2) curing food, 3) using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4) packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5) operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6) custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7) preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regulatory Authority to require a variance, or 8) sprouting seeds or beans. CDI: PIC AGREED TO PREPARE THIS MENU ITEM UNDER TEMPERATURE CONTROL AND TO ONLY KEEP IT FOR A MAXIMUM OF 6 DAYS. PLEASE APPLY FOR A VARIANCE AND WAIT FOR IT TO BE APPROVED BEFORE PARTAKING IN ACTION OUTSIDE OF THIS AGREEMENT.

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required by Law

violations.corrective_action: FOOD MAY NOT BE ACIDIFIED TO RENDER IT A NON-TCS FOOD WITHOUT AN APPROVED HACCP. PLEASE APPLY FOR A HACCP AND WAIT FOR IT TO BE APPROVED BEFORE PARTAKING IN ACTION OUTSIDE OF THIS AGREEMENT.
